name: Distal Biceps Tendon Rupture
definition: Partial or complete rupture of the distal biceps tendon from the radial tuberosity, typically after sudden eccentric load.

investigations.principle: Ultrasound or MRI confirms uncertain tears and retraction.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Complete tears in active patients are commonly repaired surgically, ideally without excessive delay.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Snayu rupture phenotype may be documented after modern tendon diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Partial or complete rupture of the distal biceps tendon from the radial tuberosity, typically after sudden eccentric load.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
